# HTML reference cases

The six pages and their JSON captures are copied from `textmetrics/tests/fixtures`
(`textmetrics` commit `4ae2745`). They cover Russian and English articles,
missing metadata, a short page, repeated blocks and an antibot page. The
reference captured the results with `rb-semkit` 0.2.11 and `pymorphy3` 2.0.6.
Tests read only these local copies; there is no dependency on the old package
or checkout.
